title: Extraction started
detail: Single lane (UK). patchright punches through Imperva where curl, Firecrawl and plain Playwright all failed.

title: Rate-block hit (~497)
detail: Home IP tripped Imperva’s per-IP limit. Challenges instead of pages — paused to cool down. ETA spikes here.

title: CAPTCHA solved → resumed
detail: A human-solved CAPTCHA clears the session (works even on a NordVPN datacenter IP). Scraping resumes.

title: Live dashboard up
detail: This page (1.6x7.gr) went live, auto-refreshing every 5 min.

title: Scaled to 6 lanes
detail: 6 parallel browsers, each on a different Nord SOCKS5 exit IP.

title: Scaled to 9 lanes
detail: Nord’s max distinct exits (9). Throughput jumps — watch the slope steepen.

title: Slowdown / possible block
detail: Smyths: failures rising fast — now 1872 (was 124), 1541/58650 done. Possible block.

title: Self-healing watchdog
detail: Watchdog upgraded to restart stuck-but-alive lanes, not just dead ones.

title: Retired dead exit → 8 lanes
detail: A NordVPN SOCKS5 exit (San Francisco) died; its share of products was redistributed to the surviving lanes.

title: Watchdog resumed
detail: Self-healing loop re-armed after a pause; iMessage alerts turned off (dashboard + chat only). Stuck lane revived.

title: Lanes restarted
detail: 0 dead + 6 stuck lane(s) relaunched (datacenter exit degradation).

title: Lane churn
detail: 0 relaunched, 4 paused (degraded datacenter exits cooling down).

title: Residential proxy tested
detail: Bright Data residential still got challenged by Imperva — its proxy terminates SSL (MITM), so the TLS fingerprint looks non-browser.

title: Free fleet burning out
detail: NordVPN datacenter exits degraded to ~1 reliable lane; throughput fell to ~10/min.

title: Lane churn
detail: 0 relaunched, 3 paused (degraded datacenter exits cooling down).
